_note: Onboarded 2026-09-22 after A265 (OTC 1,313,452 LUNA → 70,000 USDC) and A266 (Estima grant, 125,000 USDC in milestones) executed early and never reached the Alert Center — the cron discovers DAOs by folder, and this folder did not exist. The core address is the PD DAO (DAODAO core, the same address that holds VE_GUARDIAN in the Eris ve3 config per known_contracts.json); the cron asks the core for its proposal modules on chain. The setup contract is where PD's OTC sales and milestone grants are configured — proposals target it with {setup:{name, action:{otc|milestone}}}. Add vetted contracts to grade proposal targets as trusted.
